note: Operator-facing classification of every GitHub Actions workflow in this repository. PRODUCTION runs the product. EVIDENCE_CLOSED / DIAGNOSTIC_CLOSED are kept as historical proof and are already refused at runtime by their own gates -- they are archived, never deleted. tests/test_workflow_registry.py fails if a workflow file is added, removed, or reclassified without updating this file.

classes.PRODUCTION_SCHEDULED: Runs on cron. Keeps the product alive.
classes.EVIDENCE_CLOSED: Proof complete. Its own runtime gate refuses a re-run.
classes.CANARY_CLOSED: Platform already WRITE_VERIFIED; canary gate returns already_WRITE_VERIFIED.
classes.DIAGNOSTIC_CLOSED: Read-only investigation whose finding is recorded. Kept as history.
classes.OPTIONAL_TEST_ONLY: Not the production path. Never the Autofresh Telegram bot.

bump_super_parrain.yml.note: FUSED_UPDATE_BUMP, ~24h cooldown + persistent jitter. Do not touch without a proven problem.

bump_autres.yml.note: Healthy combined cycle. ReferralCode.tv is deliberately NOT in TARGET_SITES.

bump_referralcode_tv.yml.note: Isolated best-effort bump. An expected Turnstile challenge is reported, never retried, never bypassed, and never fails the run.

hermes_operator.yml.note: Hermes → AutoFresh backend command path. run_writers defaults to false.

activation_canary.yml.note: Scheduled daily at the first eligible Super-Parrain window plus retries, and operator-dispatchable. Shares the parrainage-bumper-super concurrency group with bump_super_parrain.yml so only one live saver runs at a time.
